title: mentha lapponica subsp. parietariifolia
intro: Mentha lapponica subsp. parietariifolia, commonly known as Arctic mint, is a subspecies of the Mentha lapponica species, a type of mint plant native to the Arctic regions. The health benefits of Arctic mint include its ability to aid digestion, reduce nausea and vomiting, and provide relief from headaches and fever. The therapeutic actions of Arctic mint include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Arctic mint include volatile oils, such as menthone and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and aroma.
